ad-roi.contract: ROI=(revenue-adSpend)/adSpend*100; ROAS=revenue/adSpend; revenue>=0, adSpend>0, both finite real numbers. These are advertising-only costs, not full business profit.
fixes: Boolean/malformed/nonfinite required fields now error rather than coercion/defaults. Negative revenue rejected. Overflow errors explicitly.
Renamed revenue-minus-ad-spend result so it no longer claims net campaign profit. Corrected gross revenue input, attribution, margin and break-even distinctions.
independentExamples: 200000 revenue/50000 ad spend => 300% ROI, 4:1 ROAS, 150000 revenue-minus-ads
20% contribution before ads on 200000 revenue gives 40000; subtracting 50000 ads gives -10000 despite displayed positive simplified ROI
remainingHumanChecks: Confirm product terminology for simplified advertising ROI and review attribution wording.

aov.contract: revenue>=0 divided by positive safe whole order count; same revenue/order cohort and accounting basis.
fixes: Reject active booleans, malformed/nonfinite values and unsafe counts.
Removed claims that larger baskets are free to obtain or necessarily more profitable; preserved subject FAQs on refunds, delivery and whole orders.
remainingHumanChecks: Review order/revenue accounting conventions for intended merchant audience.

day-of-week.contract: Valid four-digit Gregorian date, year1..9999; weekday and ordinal independent of timezone; Monday ISO weeks use the Thursday week-year; weekend means Saturday/Sunday.
fixes: 2024-12-31 was week53, now ISO2025-W01. 2023-01-01 placeholder now numeric ISO2022-W52.
Added separate localized ISO week-year result. UTC calendar components avoid local DST/whole-day omissions and JS1900 offset for years1..99.
Clarified historical Gregorian projection without automatic Julian/country transition conversion and weekend without legal holiday calendar.
independentExamples: 2024-02-29 Thursday ordinal60 ISO2024-W09; 1900/2100 not leap; 2000 leap
0001-01-01 Monday ISO1-W01; 0099-12-31 Thursday ISO99-W53; 9999-12-31 Friday ISO9999-W52
2011-12-30 Friday Gregorian date; old local shared parser rejected it in Pacific/Apia
remainingHumanChecks: Native date widget browser review for early years and timezone transition dates in all published locales.
Human review of Gregorian historical-calendar limitation and weekend description.

difference-abs-rel.contract: delta=to-from (signed unit difference); relative=delta/abs(from)*100 when from!=0; at zero only the unit difference exists.
fixes: Reject malformed/boolean/nonfinite inputs and overflow.
Preserved negative-base semantics rather than substituting percentage-calculator denominator; made signed meaning explicit in steps, limitation and metadata.
remainingHumanChecks: Confirm established title absolute difference is adequately explained as signed unit difference.

dividend-yield.contract: annualDividend/sharePrice*100; dividend>=0, price>0; optional shares>=0 may be fractional, blank means omit holding. Dividend/price and holding totals must remain finite.
fixes: Negative or malformed optional shares no longer silently omit holding; booleans and nonfinite required inputs error.

Clarified annual dividend input, current-price vs purchase-cost yield, no live quotes, taxes, capital-gain total return or guaranteed payouts. Removed unsupported empirical high-yield generalisations.
independentExamples: Dividend0=>0%; price0 invalid; blank shares omitted
remainingHumanChecks: Human financial review of yield terminology and tax example conventions.

logarithm.contract: log_b(x)=ln(x)/ln(b), x>0, b>0,b!=1; mode log10/ln/custom only. Fixed modes ignore inactive base.
fixes: Unknown mode no longer silently defaults to log10; strict active numeric guards and explicit overflow/underflow check.
Valid tiny input no longer rendered falsely as log(0); near-one valid base no longer shown as exactly1.
Explained positive fractional bases, complex-number exclusion and approximate rounded power check.
independentExamples: x=1e-100 => -100 with scientific notation in the written/check rows
Fixed-base ln/log10 accept inactive malformed base; custom mode requires valid base
remainingHumanChecks: Human mathematical review of rounding/scientific notation wording.

return-rate.contract: uniqueReturnedOrders/wholeCohortOrders*100; safe integers 0<=returns<=orders and orders>0. Complement is 100%-rate, not a guarantee no future return will occur.
fixes: Reject boolean/malformed/nonfinite counts and unsafe integers.
Use matching order cohort rather than mixing sale-month and return-month events; remove unsupported industry normal-rate ranges and universal cause claims.
independentExamples: 901/900, negatives, fractions and zero orders invalid
remainingHumanChecks: Review partial-return policy language and same observation-window advice.

revenue-per-employee.contract: annualRevenue/positive safe whole employee headcount; monthly average=annual ratio/12; no fractional FTE.
fixes: Reject malformed/nonfinite/boolean inputs and unsafe counts.

Corrected all-locale FAQ recommending fractional FTE against integer-only form; monthly value is an annual average, not wages/profit/seasonal monthly actual. Removed industry order-of-magnitude generalisation.
remainingHumanChecks: Review chosen headcount convention explanation; this implementation intentionally keeps existing integer contract.

roi.contract: total=invested+extra>0; ROI=(received-total)/total*100; all amounts nonnegative finite; optional blank extra0. Time and intermediate cash flows not modelled.
fixes: Negative/malformed/nonfinite extra no longer silently drops; bool required/optional inputs error; intermediate overflow errors.
Annualised loss calculation not falsely delegated to a compound tool that rejects negative rates; explicit separate annualisation formula for no intermediate cash flows.
independentExamples: Received0 with total100000=>-100%; invested0 extra50 received100=>100%
remainingHumanChecks: Human financial review of investment-basis and annualisation assumptions.

shipping-per-unit.contract: (wholeBatchShipping+wholeBatchPackaging)/positive safe whole units; costs>=0, optional blank packaging0. No carrier tariff or weight/volume allocation.
fixes: Negative/malformed/nonfinite packaging no longer silently drops; all active booleans error, safe counts and explicit total overflow.
Corrected universal fixed/variable tariff statements and UK mixed-batch advice to distinguish manual external weighting from equal allocation actually provided.
remainingHumanChecks: Review batch-vs-item packaging wording and mixed-item cost-allocation limitations.

ad-roi.reason: Google Ads defines full ROI with relevant costs; supports stating the narrower boundary here, not claiming this advertising-only model is full net ROI.

day-of-week.reason: Python official docs describe ISO first-Thursday and separate ISO week-year; independent oracle used.

dividend-yield.reason: FINRA explains annual dividend/price yield and that dividends may be cut; educational information, not globally normative financial law.
